title: Staged epochal rollouts with SLO gates and LTS channel affinity for Hosted API
creator: Liam O'Connor
description:
Background: Our current Hosted API deployment pipeline supports canary and blue/green shifts but lacks a cohesive concept of epochal/staged rollouts tied to LTS channels and automated SLO-based gating. This causes manual coordination during region-by-region upgrades and inconsistent rollback behavior when regional SLOs spike.

Goal: Implement a "epochal" rollout controller that: (1) groups traffic shifts into deterministic epochs (eg. 5%, 20%, 60%, 100%) with configurable time budgets, (2) enforces per-region SLO gates (error rate, P95 latency, token failures) that pause/abort epochs automatically, (3) honors LTS channel affinity so pinned tenants remain on their LTS lane until explicit promotion, and (4) provides an operator-facing CLI & console flow for forced promotion/rollback with audit logs. The feature must be compatible with existing blue/green pools and the smart routing fallback mechanism.
acceptance_criteria: Epoch rollout controller implementation merged and deployed to staging clusters
Controller enforces SLO gates: if region error-rate > 0.5% for 5m OR P95 latency increase >20% for 5m, the epoch pauses and marks region as degraded
Automated rollback trigger executed within 2 minutes of critical gate breach; traffic returned to previous stable epoch without orphaning session state
LTS channel affinity: tenants with lts_pin=true do not receive traffic from non-LTS model variants unless explicitly promoted via release-manager CLI
End-to-end e2e test covering epoch progression, gate pause, forced promote, and rollback present in infra/test/rollouts and passing in CI
Console UI shows epoch progress and per-region SLO delta chart and exposes one-click abort/promote actions with audit event link
plan: Phase 1 (staging): implement epoch controller and API; wire basic SLO checks from telemetry service; provide CLI to start rollouts with profile presets. Phase 2 (canary): deploy controller to canary region; test automated pause/rollback with controlled fault injection; update console with readouts and controls. Phase 3 (gradual): roll out to all regions behind feature flag and enable LTS channel enforcement; run 48-hour soak and measure rollback false positives. Phase 4 (GA): document runbook, onboard SRE rotation, and flip default feature flag for production rollouts.
